$comment: Project policy for the hooks in this directory, in the Hatchery base's format (its ADR 0006; the loader is policy.js). Every script here and ../statusline.js is the base's and reads this file (ADR 0035, ADR 0037). git: agents push and lease-push task/* only, never commit on main or master but may pull, merge or rebase there (git.integrate, ADR 0036), delete a task/* branch only after a merged PR, and core.hooksPath stays tools/git-hooks, whose pre-push chains the base's .claude/hooks/git/pre-push. usage: hold 50 on the session (5-hour) meter (owner, 2026-10-17) and 75 on the weekly one; deny 100, so an owner's grant in ~/.claude/usage-gate-overrides/ lifts either meter or both; DYSTOPO_GATE_OVERRIDE=1 in a session's environment lifts HOLD for that session. edit: the docs exempt from the 300-line cap; CLAUDE.md named exactly lifts the base's 40-line and 190-loaded caps (ADR 0038, ADR 0037 before it); anchorExempt is the base's closed records (the board, PLANNING and ARCHITECTURE are checked again since the anchor check skips elided paths such as shared/.../X.kt, T117). update: base paths this project never takes (ADR 0020, ADR 0037). privacy: the base's push scan (its ADR 0018); identities holds the owner's own identity, the one every pushed commit carries, listed as Hatchery's policy lists it (owner, 2026-10-21, replacing a placeholder the 2026-10-17 update had invented); the scan exempts it in author, committer and tagger fields and in this file only. Check with: node .claude/hooks/policy.js

usage.holdAdvice: No new implementers (CLAUDE.md, Wave size). Finish work already in flight; a verifier for an already-launched task needs the owner's override. Otherwise wait for the reset or the owner's word.
